subject.title: refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Should the SQLite session/transcript migration ship together with keep-by-default reset/deleted archives and a default 2 GiB session disk budget?
rationale: The storage flip is aligned with repository architecture, but the bundled retention changes alter deletion, disk, downgrade, and operator expectations independently of the migration mechanics.

options.title: Split retention policy
options.body: Land the SQLite canonical-store migration with the prior cleanup defaults, then review keep-by-default archives and the 2 GiB budget separately.

options.title: Approve combined migration
options.body: Accept the migration and retention redesign together after the resource leak, docs, exact-head checks, and live upgrade proof are complete.

options.title: Pause release inclusion
options.body: Keep the branch open until the upgrade, recovery, and operator-impact evidence is stronger.

recommendation.title: Split retention policy
recommendation.body: Land the SQLite canonical-store migration with the prior cleanup defaults, then review keep-by-default archives and the 2 GiB budget separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits own the retention policy and schema integration, and the discussion specifically requests design sign-off on those defaults.
